chapeau.line: When the budgetary unit participates in the Lifeline Assistance Program, a telephone expense is allowable when one or more of the following apply:

lines.line: ● The discount program does not pay the expense in full
● Extra airtime is purchased after exhausting free minutes

reason: The chapeau says 'one or more of the following apply'; each bullet alone makes the telephone expense allowable for a Lifeline participant.
not_examined: That Lifeline participation is a separate input from the two listed conditions.
That the candidate requires Lifeline participation AND at least one of the two listed conditions.
That each of the two listed conditions has an input, and that they are combined with OR.
owner_must_verify: The Lifeline path of the formula is: participates in Lifeline AND (discount does not pay in full OR extra airtime purchased after exhausting free minutes).
Lifeline participation alone does not make the expense allowable on that path.
No listed condition is negated, dropped, or reachable only through a constant.

chapeau.line: Any of the following utility expenses are considered heating sources when used to provide heat for the home:

lines.line: Any of the following are considered cooling sources:
The cost for any of the following supplemental sources of heating or cooling do not qualify for the SUA:
● Equipment for cutting wood (i.e. chainsaws, chainsaw maintenance, axe)

reason: The bullets list the utility expenses that are each a heating source when used to provide heat; the later lists are separate sentences about cooling sources and excluded costs.
not_examined: That 'used to provide heat for the home' is a separate input from the kind of utility expense.
That the candidate requires a listed expense AND use to provide heat for the home.
That every listed expense (electricity; gas or propane; coal, wood, or oil) is encoded, combined with OR.
owner_must_verify: A heating source is: (electricity OR gas OR propane OR coal OR wood OR oil) AND used to provide heat for the home.
No listed expense is missing, and the heat-use fact is not dropped or ORed with the list.
The cooling-source and excluded-cost lists are not conditions of the heating-source rule.

chapeau.line: The budgetary unit is entitled to a utility allowance based on utility expenses verified when either situation occurs:

lines.line: ● More than one budgetary unit lives in the same residence and shares utility expenses.
● One budgetary unit shares a housing unit with others who do not receive NA.

reason: The chapeau says 'either situation occurs'; each bullet is one situation, so the two bullets are alternatives.
not_examined: That the two situations are combined with OR and that both are encoded.
The two facts inside the first situation (another budgetary unit lives in the same residence AND shares utility expenses): the check does not require separate inputs for them.
The facts inside the second situation (shares a housing unit with others AND those others do not receive NA).
That verified utility expenses are a separate input from the situations.
owner_must_verify: The allowance path is: utility expenses verified AND (situation 1 OR situation 2).
Situation 1 requires both: more than one budgetary unit lives in the same residence, and they share utility expenses.
Situation 2 requires both: the unit shares a housing unit with others, and those others do not receive NA.
Neither situation is dropped, and the two are not combined with AND.
